card.name: Frequency words after a dose amount
card.fires_on: Words that give how often a dose is taken, such as per, every, daily, day, week, and given, right after a dose amount in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Per/every units
modes.description: The unit word of a dosing interval right after per, every, or each.
modes.example: The starting dose is 0.375 mg given once<< per>> day.

modes.label: Frequency right after dose
modes.description: A frequency or administration word directly after the amount, such as daily, every, or given.
modes.example: 1 g salt (600 mg base)<< daily>> for two days, followed by 5

modes.label: Schedule range words
modes.description: Linking words that open a day range or split-dose list within a schedule.
modes.example: 4 mg per day taken orally on Days 1<< through>> 21 of repeated 28

card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing instruction where the schedule, such as once a day or every week, is being stated.
